pools.ARCH: every reconstructed row of the source window archive (Sobol 2,048 + local search), folds A and B only
pools.ARCH-S: descriptive budget-matched ablation: the first 1,024 archived Sobol rows (vs NEW-S); enters no verdict
pools.NEW: this study: 1,024 Sobol + ≤ 128 refinements per ETF and fold (training-only, objective T)
pools.NEW-S: NEW without refinements (Sobol only; the refinement ablation)

arms.A0: sealed source representative (survivor) and library; folds A and B, ARCH only
arms.A0r: the narrow rule on the pool: top 8 by J_s (distinct signatures), J_nb over 16 draws, representative, library ≤ 4
arms.A1: top-K families by J_s, nominee = max J_nb (16 draws), J_nb > 0 and J_s > 0
arms.A1n: descriptive ablation: top-K credible by J_s with distinct signatures (no family deduplication), A1’s nominee rule; enters no verdict
arms.A2: top-K families by T, nominee = max T_nb (16 draws) among members with ≥ 2 entry years, T_nb > 0
arms.A3: top-K families by order-independent support (credible Sobol vectors within d ≤ 0.5 of the medoid; members = medoids), 48 draws, filters (profitable ≥ 75%, DD ≤ $35k ≥ 75%, worst ≥ −$15k, ≥ 2 catalog families), nominee = max P25 > 0
arms.A4: nested: A2(K) library, nominee = max selection-window V with ≥ 1 lot and windowed minute DD ≤ $35k, V > 0

seeds.draws: neighbour(books, stage, cls, draw) with the source seed label 'd1-ranked-preemption'; stages: A 'standalone:fold-a', B 'standalone:fold-b', S18 'd1-wide-library:S18', S19 'd1-wide-library:S19', S20 'd1-wide-library:S20', S22 'd1-wide-library:S22'

executionOrder: fold A: fold-a census (post-freeze) → search → sample parity → libraries
phase A evaluation (→ 2021-12-31) → T1 nested selection
fold B: fold-b reconstruction → census → search → sample parity → libraries
phase B, phase T1-later, phases S18, S19, S20, S22
final-window reconstruction and census (census only) → analysis → tables
calendarDoor: a load ending E refuses unless every fold SELECTION with cutoff < E and every nested SELECTION with selection end < E is sealed and verifies
metrics: realized K, families, credible, A0-library family coverage, discarded families
ETFs with a nominee, window lots, ETFs with any window lot
Σ / mean / median V over 61 ETFs (no nominee = 0) at 0/2/5/10 bps
windowed minute and daily DD, breaches > $35,000, worst window lot and MAE, ES proxy (mean of the worst 10% of window lot nets)
interest, friction, lot-days, net per $1M borrowing dollar-days in the window
window catalog episodes/families, dip-captured share, major-family capture, independent events, continuation trades, falling knives
portfolio overlay: window equity increment over C0, max daily % DD after the boundary
paired vs A0r: mean ΔV (5, 10), W/L/I, cluster CW/CL, breaches
A4: selection V vs later V, random-pick expectation, rank correlation, single-lot picks

decisionRules.baseline: the sealed A0 on ARCH (A0r wherever reproduced), A0r on every other pool
decisionRules.favourable: evaluable ∧ mean ΔV(5) > 0 ∧ mean ΔV(10) > 0 ∧ W > L ∧ CW > CL ∧ B_arm ≤ B_base + 1
decisionRules.riskIncompatible: B_arm ≥ B_base + 3 (B = nominees with fast-path windowed minute DD > $35,000 at 5 bps)
decisionRules.insufficient: W + L < 10, or CW + CL < 5, or < 10 ETFs with V ≠ 0 for the arm, or < 10 for the baseline, or < 10 eligible window catalog families (61 ETFs together); neither favourable nor unfavourable; K denominator stays 4
decisionRules.improves: favourable in both primary folds at K = 8 and K = 16 and (at K = 32 in both folds or at K = 64 in both folds); never risk-incompatible
decisionRules.worse: unfavourable in both primary folds at K = 8 and 16 and (at 32 in both or at 64 in both), or risk-incompatible in either fold at K = 16
decisionRules.precedence: improves → worse → insufficient evidence → no evidence → mixed (the first rule that holds applies)
decisionRules.insufficientVerdict: an insufficient K = 16 cell in either primary fold (→ mixed / inconclusive at study level)
decisionRules.noEvidence: favourable in neither primary fold at K = 16 (and not worse, not insufficient)
decisionRules.acrossEtf: Δ top-5 Σ V > 0 at 5 and 10 bps in both folds at K = 8, 16 and 32 or 64 (improves); < 0 at 5 bps likewise (worse); else mixed
decisionRules.nested: primary cell T1/NEW; a cell (first rule first): favourable iff A4(K) favourable against both A2(K) and the baseline at K = 8, 16 and (32 or 64, the same K in both folds/comparisons); worse iff unfavourable against both likewise; insufficient iff either K = 16 comparison is insufficient; no evidence iff neither K = 16 comparison is favourable; else mixed. Verdict: retains an advantage iff T1/NEW favourable and T1/NEW-S not worse; is worse iff T1/NEW worse; else T1/NEW’s state. Nested across-ETF: improves iff improves against both top-5 comparators; worse iff worse against both; else mixed. T2 secondary, never a replication; reported beside, not inside, the study outcome
studyOutcome: evidence for an improved selection procedure: an arm "improves" on ARCH, is "worse" on neither NEW nor ALL, and is favourable in ≥ 3 of 5 rolling years
new procedure is materially worse: A1, A2 and A3 all "worse" on ARCH
mixed / inconclusive: neither, and some arm favourable at K = 16 in both primary folds on some verdict pool, or "improves" on a non-ARCH pool, or "insufficient evidence" on ARCH
